AboutMe.title: About Me
AboutMe.subtitle: Java backend, Full Stack perspective
AboutMe.aboutText1: I am a Java Developer at Code Group, assigned to Núclea, working in the financial sector. I develop with Java and Spring Boot and bring a Full Stack perspective to connect APIs, integrations and interfaces with the needs of the people using the software.
AboutMe.aboutText2: I pursue good outcomes by understanding the problem before building a solution. To me, excellence means attention to business rules, clear code and ownership of delivery, from development through maintenance. This is how I aim to build useful applications that can evolve consistently.
AboutMe.aboutText3: I also use AI agents and system integrations through MCP in my development workflow. With SDD, I organize requirements and decisions into specifications that guide implementation. AI supports this work; critical thinking, review and validation remain part of my technical responsibility.
AboutMe.aboutText4: My education began with a technical course in Software Development and includes participation in SP Skills 2024. I am now studying Software Engineering at Unimar, continuing to develop my backend, cloud and architecture skills and applying what I learn at work and in personal projects.
